outcome: Safety events within 30 days of procedures
Reoperations within one year of procedures
cohort: 8048 women undergoing hysteroscopic sterilization and 44,278 undergoing laparoscopic sterilization between 2005 and 2013 in New York State
finding: Patients undergoing hysteroscopic sterilization have a similar risk of unintended pregnancy but a more than 10-fold higher risk of undergoing reoperation compared with patients undergoing laparoscopic sterilization.
mod_finding: This study compared hysteroscopic and laparoscopic sterilization, finding similar unintended pregnancy rates but a higher reoperation risk with hysteroscopic sterilization.
